verses.text: Finally, brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus: keep living in a way that pleases God, just as we taught you. You're already doing this—keep growing in it.
You know the instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
God wants you to be made holy: stay away from sexual immorality.
Each of you should learn to control your own body in holiness and honor,
not giving in to passionate desires like the Gentiles who don't know God.
In this matter, don't take advantage of or wrong a fellow believer. The Lord will punish such behavior, as we already warned and testified to you.
God didn't call us to impurity but to holiness.
Whoever rejects this instruction isn't rejecting a human being but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
About love for fellow believers, you don't need us to write you. God himself has taught you to love one another.
And you do love all the believers throughout Macedonia. Still, brothers and sisters, we urge you to keep growing in this love.
Make it your goal to live quietly, mind your own business, and work with your hands, just as we instructed you.
Then people outside the church will respect the way you live, and you won't have to depend on anyone.
Brothers and sisters, we don't want you to be uninformed about those who have died, so you won't grieve like people who have no hope.
We believe Jesus died and rose again. In the same way, God will bring with Jesus those who have died trusting him.
Here's what we tell you by the Lord's word: we who are alive and remain until the Lord comes will certainly not go ahead of those who have died.
The Lord himself will come down from heaven with a loud command, with the archangel's voice and God's trumpet. Those who died in Christ will rise first.
Then we who are still alive will be caught up with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.
So encourage one another with these words.
